risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company must convince surgeons and hospitals that its products represent an attractive alternative to competitors' products and existing surgical treatments. Pricing pressures from competitors could impact profitability.

risks.title: FDA Regulation and Product Approvals
risks.score_rationale: Products are subject to extensive government regulation, including FDA approvals, 510(k), de novo, HDE, and PMA. Changes in approval policies or delays could prevent revenue generation.

risks.title: Litigation and Regulatory Compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to litigation risks related to non-compliance with FDA regulations. Regulatory enforcement could discourage surgeons and affect product reputation.

risks.title: Supplier Dependence
risks.score_rationale: Although the company has increased its internal manufacturing capacity, it still relies on third-party suppliers for production, primarily based in the United States. Loss of key suppliers could harm operations.

risks.title: Coverage and Reimbursement
risks.score_rationale: If customers cannot obtain adequate coverage and reimbursement for purchasing the products, the company will not be able to sell them profitably.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company uses information systems and networks to manage its operations, including for its INR solutions and neuromonitoring services, and is exposed to cyberattacks.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks and Exchange Rate Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in approximately 64 countries. Geopolitical risks, political changes, and exchange rate fluctuations could affect international operations, which represent 19.4% of revenue.

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not mention AI or machine learning in the provided 10-K report excerpts. The focus is on enabling surgical technologies (imaging, navigation, robotics) and musculoskeletal solutions, but without explicit reference to AI.
